mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slack condition with UNRATE exceeding 6.5% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL above 215 and FEDFUNDS above 0.35 signals an accelerating inflationary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 215 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.35 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a HOUST decline below 800 thousand and RSAFS increase above 350,000 million dollars signal weakening housing demand and rising consumer credit, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 800 AND RSAFS > 350000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A INDPRO level above 105 (indicating stronger industrial production) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects robust economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 105 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST level below 800 thousand units signals housing market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer wealth and spending.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 800 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous PAYEMS increase above 136,000 and UNRATE decrease below 6.7% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to rising wage pressures and inflation.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 136000 AND UNRATE < 6.7 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a FEDFUNDS rise above 0.5% and CPIAUCSL rise above 215.0 signals hawkish policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher interest rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 215.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
